observation.visible_scene: A close view of a fiery, smoky environment. The left and lower portions are filled with dark, billowing smoke clouds lit from within by deep red-orange glow patches, while the upper-right region contains a bright yellow-orange luminous mass. A dense field of small, elongated bright streaks (glowing embers/sparks) is scattered across the whole frame.
visible_changes: The bright yellow-orange glow in the upper-right corner steadily intensifies and expands, gradually flooding the top-right quadrant by the end of the excerpt.
The dark smoke and the red-glowing cloud masses on the left/center continuously deform and shift shape; the central-left red patch drifts slightly and changes outline over time.

The numerous ember streaks persist throughout but individually drift and flicker: tracked streaks move upward and toward the right, and their brightness varies from frame to frame, keeping an overall roughly uniform density.
Global contrast rises as the right side brightens relative to the still-dark lower-left smoke.
outside_clip_unknowns: What produces the fire/glow and the embers, the scale of the scene, and whether it is indoor or outdoor.
The state of the fire before the excerpt began and after it ends (the glow is already brightening at frame 1 and is still growing at frame 41).
uncertain_details: Whether the apparent upward/rightward drift of embers and the slow shift of the smoke clouds are partly camera motion (a pan/zoom) rather than pure object movement; the amorphous background makes this hard to separate.
Exact per-particle ember trajectories and whether individual streaks are reflections or distinct particles cannot be confirmed.
